purpose: Prospectively define a biologically coherent Palearctic terrestrial-insect secondary analysis asking whether similarity in Last Glacial Maximum climatic refugial opportunity predicts source-target concordance of post-IBD spatial genetic structure.

chronology_and_claim_boundary.interpretation: This is a prospectively frozen secondary/conditional ecological reanalysis within an already-opened archive, not an independent confirmatory dataset.

coarse_response_blind_screen_seen_before.source_surface: exact phylogatR taxonomy + COI header/occurrence coordinates only
coarse_response_blind_screen_seen_before.note: This coarse count used a simple geographic approximation only. It has no authority to define membership or alter the formal thresholds below.

allowed_pre_response_surfaces: occurrence coordinates linked to selected COI headers
forbidden_before_opening: pair-specific T_st for the new subpanel
beta_LGM or any subgroup genetic coefficient

taxon.terrestrial_core_rule: Conservative order-level core; mixed aquatic orders are excluded rather than adjudicated species by species after seeing results.
taxon.rationale: Prefer a conservative terrestrial core over a post-hoc family-by-family ecological classification.

palearctic.locality_surface: exact unique coordinates linked to the selected COI-family aligned FASTA headers
palearctic.denominator: all finite selected COI localities, including localities assigned to other realms or unclassified land

role_assignment.rule: Sort retained species by SHA256('palearctic-lgm-role-v0.1|<exact_archive_sha256>|<species>'); lower floor(n/2) are sources and the remainder are targets.

lgm_climatic_suitability_model.label: presence-only climatic-envelope SDM / hindcast
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.common_climate_space: Pool current GBIF climate vectors across all externally admissible subpanel species; z-standardize four variables; canonical-sign PCA; retain all four whitened PCs.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.species_model: Isotropic Gaussian KDE in the four-dimensional whitened current-climate space with Scott bandwidth n^(-1/8).
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.projection_grid: Palearctic terrestrial cells on a fixed 0.1-degree grid, masked by RESOLVE realm polygons.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.current_suitability: Evaluate the species KDE on current CHELSA climate for each grid cell and normalize nonnegative density to sum 1.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.lgm_suitability: Project the identical frozen KDE onto LGM CHELSA climate at the same grid cells and normalize nonnegative density to sum 1.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.extrapolation_rule: No clamping or result-dependent variable replacement; report fraction of grid cells outside the pooled current climate range as a diagnostic.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.primary_relation: R_LGM_st = Schoener's D between normalized source and target LGM suitability surfaces.
lgm_climatic_suitability_model.nuisance_current_relation: R_present_st = Schoener's D between normalized source and target current suitability surfaces.

dyadic_controls.geography: directed external current geographic co-opportunity: fraction of target retained GBIF coordinates whose nearest source retained GBIF coordinate is within 500 km

opening_rule.if_any_failed: NOT_EVALUABLE_PALAEARCTIC_LGM_RELATION; do not compute pair-specific genetic T_st for this route

empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.response: T_st, source-to-target post-IBD transfer skill computed under the already frozen genetic transfer operator, restricted to the new source-target roles.
empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.model: T_st = source_FE + target_FE + beta_LGM*z_R_LGM + declared controls + error
empirical_question_if_opening_is_authori.biological_hypothesis: Palearctic terrestrial insect species with more similar LGM climatic refugial opportunity should share more reusable geography of post-IBD genetic differentiation.

interpretation.positive: Within this pre-specified Palearctic terrestrial-insect subset, similarity in LGM climatic refugial opportunity predicts where genetic spatial structure is reusable across lineages, beyond present-climate similarity, current geographic co-opportunity, taxonomy and sampling imbalance.
interpretation.qualified_null: The frozen LGM refugial-similarity relation does not explain source-target transfer heterogeneity in the tested Palearctic terrestrial-insect subset.
interpretation.not_evaluable: No biological conclusion; the subset or relation cannot support the intended claim under the frozen TTF-Q criteria.
